$comment: Literals the translation lint (tools/i18n/lint_strings.py) lets through, by file and literal, each with the lane that owns the file.
A new literal in these files fails the lint like any other; an entry whose literal is gone fails it too, so the list can only get shorter.
Whoever converts a literal removes its entry. docs/i18n.md lists, per lane, what has to change; `lint_strings.py --report` prints it.

Experience-lane files are converted now where the design has a string for the text (docs/design/strings.json). What remains here from that lane is text that has no id because nothing in the design says it.
An entry with "shown": false is not text a person reads (a developer log line, say): it is allowed, and is left out of the report of what a lane has to change.
